english.title: Officer acting in a capacity without an appropriate certificate which required a certificate of competency
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) acted in a capacity, namely **(..SPECIFY CAPACITY..), which required a certificate of

(A)_[competency,]_
(B)_[equivalent competency,]_
(C)_[service]_

under the Fishing Vessels (Certification of Deck Officers and Engineer Officers) Regulations 1984 when you did not hold an appropriate certificate
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 11(1) and 12 of the Fishing Vessels (Certification of Deck Officers and Engineer Officers) Regulations 1984.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
acted in a capacity
requiring a certificate of competency OR
certificate of equivalent competency OR
certificate of service
without such a certificate

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: In the event of the death or incapacity of any officer required to be certificated under the Fishing Vessels (Certification of Deck Officers and Engineer Officers) Regulations 1984, a deck officer or engineer officer, as appropriate, who is not certificated to act in that capacity may act in the certificated capacity until the vessel reaches the next intended port of call - regulation 11(1).

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
